notes: Reached by direct fetch (no proxy). Next.js SSR storefront; every PLP renders 'N Results for "<Category>"' and the same integer is server-embedded at __NEXT_DATA__:props.pageProps.totalProductsFromServer. Verified identical on all 38 leaf URLs. Independently proved on 3 categories by enumerating pages: total == unique tiles rendered, totalPages == ceil(total/48), and zero tiles at page+1. Category tree taken from the live /ae/en mega-menu plus the on-page Wall Arts sub-nav; cross-checked against /ae/en/sitemap/category_sitemap_ae_en.xml (1,528 category URLs). Danube's catalogue is mostly out of scope for this project: furniture, outdoor, bath/sanitaryware, tiles, hardware/DIY, electricals, appliances, cookware and all furnishings (rugs, curtains, bedding, cushions, towels) were excluded, as were Home Fragrance, Festive Decorations and Artificial Flowers per the batch rules. Parent 'Wall Arts' PLP itself shows 3,622 items but is emitted as a grouping row per the brief; its 9 live child categories total 1,064, so ~2,558 wall-art items sit only in the uncategorised parent. Deliberately dropped as mixed/out-of-scope roll-ups: 'Water Bottles & Jugs' (487 - dominated by insulated sports/steel/tritan hydration bottles), 'Trinket & Jewellery Box' (74 - jewellery organisers and storage racks), 'Tissue Holder' (20 - functional), 'Flask', 'Hot Pot', 'Cutlery', plus Lighting > Electricals and all outdoor/landscape/pool lighting (functional fittings), 'Ceiling Fans' and 'Bulbs'. 'Shop By Room' and 'Shop By Collection' lighting menus were skipped as filter/collection pages. 'Lighting By Material' is kept because material lines are explicitly in scope, but note it re-slices the same lighting catalogue as 'Lighting By Type'. /c/lighting/decorative-lights and /c/lighting/lamps-shades/lamp-shades-bases exist in the sitemap but render 0 products, so they were dropped. home-accessories/bowls is a duplicate URL for decorative-bowls-and-tray (same 99 items); only the canonical nav URL is kept.
